arrival.speaker: halden
arrival.text: *grumbles* Serene sent you? I’m not so frail that I need someone counting my aches.

arrival.speaker: caelan
arrival.text: She sent the medicine you asked about last week.

arrival.speaker: halden
arrival.text: I said I’d think about asking.

arrival.speaker: tomas
arrival.text: *grins* That’s practically a yes, for you.

arrival.speaker: halden
arrival.text: Hmph. And which one of you came to do actual work?

arrival.speaker: halden
arrival.text: Those three sacks of flour by the door. Onto the dry pallet. I’ve more coming through the mill and nowhere sensible to put it.

arrival.speaker: halden
arrival.text: People want their flour before they start baking for the Festival of Light. They’ve been very particular about telling me that.

arrival.speaker: halden
arrival.text: One sack at a time. They’re heavier than they look.

arrival.speaker: halden
arrival.text: You’ll wait until your brother’s ready.

reminder.speaker: halden
reminder.text: The three sacks of flour by the door need moving to the dry pallet. Take them one at a time.

reminder.speaker: tomas
reminder.text: I’ll take the middle one. Just say when.

conclusion.speaker: tomas
conclusion.text: You can actually get through the doorway now.

conclusion.speaker: halden
conclusion.text: I could get through it before.

conclusion.speaker: halden
conclusion.text: *after a pause* …I spent forty years carrying these myself.

conclusion.speaker: caelan
conclusion.text: Then perhaps you’ve earned the right to let someone else carry a few.

conclusion.speaker: halden
conclusion.text: Hmph. Tell Serene I’ll take the medicine.

conclusion.speaker: halden
conclusion.text: And if she asks, the wheel’s been making a dreadful racket. I’ll have it looked at.

conclusion.speaker: tomas
conclusion.text: Ask Mira. If anyone can repair it, she can.

conclusion.speaker: halden
conclusion.text: She’s got her own repairs to finish.

conclusion.speaker: caelan
conclusion.text: One more reason to ask before it becomes a bigger job.

conclusion.speaker: tomas
conclusion.text: *with a small smile* Both of us have. It’s difficult not to.

goodbye.speaker: tomas
goodbye.text: I’d better get back. Mother needs help with the preparations.

goodbye.speaker: caelan
goodbye.text: Go on. I’ve still got Elira by the southern bridge and the Venns up on the eastern terrace.

goodbye.speaker: tomas
goodbye.text: You’ll be back before we’ve finished, then?

goodbye.speaker: caelan
goodbye.text: That depends how much you get done.

goodbye.speaker: caelan
goodbye.text: And try not to turn the courtyard into a workshop.
